class.name: HTMLDocument
class.brief_description: HTML/CSS source data for an HTML render surface.
class.description: Stores pure HTML and CSS-oriented document inputs for [HTMLView], [HTMLRenderTarget], and [HTMLSurface3D]. This resource does not expose JavaScript or browser navigation behavior.

members.member: Default render size used when a surface has no explicit size.
Path to an HTML file. File loading is reserved for the renderer backend.
Base resource root used by the renderer backend for local assets.
If [code]true[/code], surfaces request a transparent background from the renderer backend.

method.name: reload
method.description: Requests that dependent surfaces reload the document.
